ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with high-intensity (white) outliers limited to localized specular reflections and edge-bound biological clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pixel distribution across approximately 95% of the visible surface; no contiguous macro-level pigmentation blobs or mottling patterns are detected on the central lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 35-45 degrees relative to the medial axes of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes; significant jagged topography visible on the inner margin of the left lobe and distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the lateral margins transitioning to sharp, upwardly-tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white/beige pixel groups located on both the left and right distal tips; three distinct circular ring-like outlines visible on the mid-surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular excision or tissue loss on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe adjacent to the median notch; extensive barnacle colonization on the distal extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple symmetrical circular ring-scars on the right lobe surface distinct from edge-bound encrustations.
